sources.title: Dunkeld, Victoria
sources.excerpt: Dunkeld is a town in Victoria, Australia, at the southern end of the Grampians National Park, in the Shire of Southern Grampians. It is approx 283 km west of Melbourne on the Glenelg Highway. The town's population is holding steady but aging. At the 2021 census, Dunkeld had a population of 688.
